**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 22 contains the only audit right binding us — Section 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") is a bare heading with no operative text, and searches for "audit" and "inspect" surface nothing broader elsewhere.

The clause matches the **preferred** position on every material term:
- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (§22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, without unreasonable disruption (§22.1)
- **Method:** off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§22.2)
- **System access:** expressly barred — no direct access to our systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or other suppliers' confidential information (§22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further protection in our favour (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, shortfall payment resolves the issue absent fraud or demonstrable error). Nothing here warrants a redline.
